import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {tmpdir} from 'node:os';import fs from 'node:fs';import path from 'node:path';import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';const root=fs.realpathSync(fileURLToPath(new URL('.',import.meta.url)));assert.equal(fs.realpathSync(tmpdir()),root);for(const key of ['TMP','TEMP','TMPDIR'])assert.equal(fs.realpathSync(process.env[key]),root);fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root,'env-'+process.pid+'.json'),JSON.stringify({pid:process.pid,tmpdir:tmpdir(),time:new Date().toISOString()}));
const receipt=path.join(root,'env-'+process.pid+'.json');function recordExit(code){const info=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(receipt,'utf8'));info.closed=new Date().toISOString();info.exitCode=code;fs.writeFileSync(receipt,JSON.stringify(info));}process.on('exit',recordExit);
